status.en: 249 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 249 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Armed Naga militants continue fighting in Manipur's Noney district, exchanging fire and killing insurgents while seizing weapons, and a military vehicle fell into a gorge in Ladakh, killing two army personnel. The Manipur chief minister warned insurgent groups of UAPA action and ordered reports on groups linked to the attacks, while security measures were heightened on the Northern Railway at Jammu stations ahead of upcoming festivals. LG Manoj Sinha chaired a high-level meeting reviewing prison security and coordination among security agencies in Jammu and Kashmir, and a special court sentenced three CPI (Maoist) members to ten years in prison in Chhattisgarh. The conflict produced 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Væpnede Naga-militante fortsetter kampene i Manipurs Noney-distrikt, utveksler ild og dreper opprørere mens de tar våpen, og et militært kjøretøy falt ned i en gorge i Ladakh, og to soldater døde. Manipur sin statsminister advarte opprørsgrupper om UAPA-tiltak og beordret rapporter om grupper knyttet til angrepene, mens sikkerhetstiltak ble skjerpet på Nordbane ved Jammu-stasjonene før kommende festivaler. LG Manoj Sinha ledet et høyt nivå møtet som gjennomgikk fengselsikkerhet og koordinering mellom sikkerhetsbyråer i Jammu og Kashmir, og en spesiell domstol dømte tre CPI (Maoist)-medlemmer til ti år i fengsel i Chhattisgarh. Konflikten førte til 437 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
